subject: persistent first-person hand draw hook

hook.restore_mechanism: host image_restore in shutdown; the patch is memory-only and dies with the process
hook.forwarding: every non-matching glDrawElements is passed to the saved original

hand_draw_signature.note: 4752 = 1188 x 4. The two adjacent 1188-index draws are two passes over one uint32 index run, not two 16-bit runs.

log_lines: info: dispatch hook installed at rva 0x3d9ac8 (original=0x7bee1450 mode=suppress)
info: dispatch hook installed at rva 0x3d9ac8 (original=0x7bee1450 mode=pass-through)
limitations: The suppress run exited a few seconds after the capture with no hyprlodr-crash.json; the pass-mode control stayed alive more than 20 seconds after launch with the original arm visible, so the hook's presence alone is not the cause. Sustained suppression is still unproven.
Neither run produced a loader shutdown log, so the in-game image_restore path has not been exercised; the patch is memory-only and cannot persist after process exit.

The first shim version called the host logger from the render thread and the game died on the first gameplay hand draw; the shipped shim performs no host or GL calls and only counts, suppresses and forwards.
Only suppression is proven. Geometry substitution through the same hook is not implemented yet.
